subject: Accelerated evaluation MAP — draft, risk plan, and week-0 workshop proposal
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>
To: Eliza Gomez <eliza@pedantix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerated evaluation MAP — draft, risk plan, and week-0 workshop proposal

Hi Eliza —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I’m sharing a short, accelerated MAP template that frames a 45-day pilot-to-decision sprint and calls out the minimum acceptance criteria we’ll need to evaluate success. I’ve attached a working Google Doc (link below) so we can co-author.

Quick asks from your side so we can lock dates:
- Can you confirm the two business stakeholders who will approve the acceptance criteria?
- Any must-have technical constraints (data retention, network restrictions, on-prem connectors)?
- Are procurement/legal going to need a separate package prior to kickoff?

Proposed week-0 workshop: Oct 6, 10:00–11:30 AM PT — technical kickoff + success-metric alignment (calendar invite link below). If that works I’ll send invites and a lightweight agenda.

Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAP-template-accelerated-v1 (editable)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=week0-workshop-20261006

Attachments: MAP-template-accelerated-v1.gdoc (stub) — top-level sections: objectives, success metrics, tech checklist, milestone schedule (week0, week2 pilot, week4 evaluation, week6 acceptance).

Notes on timing: because you mentioned a regulatory milestone in mid-November, the 45-day window gets us to an internal decision point around Nov 13 which should still feed that date. If procurement/legal need extra time we’ll call that out in the MAP and add a gating step.

Thanks — I’ll be on stand-by to co-edit the doc this morning.

– Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions PM | Redwood Inference
<aisha@redwood.inference>

From: Eliza Gomez <eliza@pedantix.ai>

Cc: procurement@pedantix.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerated evaluation MAP — draft, risk plan, and week-0 workshop proposal

Thanks Aisha — I’ve skimmed the doc and appreciate the clear milestones. A couple of items from our side:

- Can we push the week-0 kickoff to the week of Oct 11 instead of Oct 6? Our chief architect is out next week and we want them in the kickoff.
- Our legal team needs a short summary of data retention / log handling for the pilot (how long KV caches + request logs are kept; whether logs include user text).
- Procurement attached a short checklist (see attached) — they’ll want a procurement path documented in the MAP so they can estimate timelines.

Success metric we care about: reduction in moderation false positives for our knowledge-base augmentation use-case; please add a simple accuracy/precision target we can test against.

Attachment: pedantix-procurement.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>, Eliza Gomez <eliza@pedantix.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerated evaluation MAP — draft, risk plan, and week-0 workshop proposal

Eliza / Aisha — quick internal note to flag a couple of operational constraints and suggested mitigations before we lock the timeline:

Priority risks and proposed mitigations:
- Data retention / logs: we should include a pilot default of 7 days for content-level logs and 30 days for aggregated telemetry; offer a locked-mode config (no logs persisted) for regulated tests. Action: Aisha to add the config options to the MAP.
- Security review: small SOC/security checklist required before we run the pilot in a VPC environment — typically a 5-business-day turnaround once we have the checklist items.
- Acceptance gating: recommend a two-step gating (functional pass + business sign-off) to avoid procurement blocking decisions.

Timing note: pushing kickoff to Oct 11 is fine — it shifts the 45-day window to Nov 25, which still meets your mid-Nov milestone but compresses time for procurement. If procurement is slower we can treat the procurement sign-off as a parallel track.

Suggested week-0 agenda (30–45 min tech + 45 min metrics + 15 min ops):
- Introductions & roles
- Pilot scope & excluded modules
- Success metric definitions (owner: Pedantix product)
- Data handling & security constraints (owner: Redwood security)
- Milestone sign-offs and calendar

Aisha — I added a short risk appendix in the MAP doc and flagged the security checklist requirement. I’ll be available in the October 11 slot if we confirm.

– Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
